exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR TAKRORI - 20 ta
  bo'shliq.

  PRESENT PERFECT so'zlari:
    hasn't gone back YET; Have you
    EVER had mumps?; has been in
    Rio FOR three weeks; haven't
    smoked SINCE last month; How
    LONG have you been working?
  PAST PERFECT so'zlari: had
    ALREADY left; had NEVER eaten;
    had JUST mopped; had cooked
    BEFORE guests arrived
  Uy ishlari: Have you MADE your
    bed?; TOO tired to do the
    ironing
  Salomatlik/xavf: KEEP medicines
    away; You'll BURN your finger;
    comes ON duty; helped John TO
    safety; couldn't SAY a word;
    searched FOR the ring
  Boshqa: SORRY I didn't call;
    except FOR James; WHEN was the
    last time?


⚠ 'MUMPS':

  = tepki (kasallik).


⚠ 'TO BE ON DUTY':

  = navbatchilikda bo'lmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
7-8-UNITLAR LUG'ATI VA
  GRAMMATIKASI.

  1 didn't go out UNTIL it had
    stopped = to'xtaguncha
  2 EXHIBITS in a museum =
    eksponatlar
  3 I'm AFRAID I can't = afsuski
  4 a SCHOOL of whales = kitlar
    to'dasi
  5 deep in THOUGHT = o'yga botgan
  6 What's WRONG, John? = nima
    bo'ldi?
  7 GUIDED tours = gid bilan sayohat
  8 The boat started to SINK =
    cho'ka boshladi
  9 a BROKEN bone = singan suyak
  10 She WAS HAVING coffee when ...
    (past continuous)


⚠ HAYVON TO'DALARI:

  a flock of birds/sheep; a herd of
  cows/elephants; a school of
  whales/fish.


⚠ 'TWISTED':

  = burilgan (ankle - to'piq).

tasks.prompt: We didn't go out ___ it had stopped raining.
There aren't many ___ in this museum.
I'm ___ I can't help you with the cleaning.
We saw a ___ of whales in the distance.
He was so deep in ___ that he didn't hear the knock on the door.
tasks.promptUz: U shunchalik o'yga botgan ediki, eshik taqillaganini eshitmadi.

tasks.prompt: What's ___ John?

tasks.promptUz: Jim gid bilan sayohatlarni yomon ko'radi.

tasks.prompt: The boat started to ___ slowly.
Have you ever had a ___ bone?
She ___ coffee when the phone rang.
tasks.promptUz: Telefon jiringlaganda u qahva ichayotgan edi.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Uzoq harakat + qisqa uzilish → past continuous.

exercises.explanationUz:
RUXSAT, UZR, SALOMATLIK
  DIALOGLARI.

  1 'No, you can't' → Can I go to
    the park?
  2 Uzrga javob → Never MIND. That's
    OK.
  3 'terrible earache' → What's THE
    MATTER / WRONG, Jenny?
  4 'Sure' → Is IT OK IF I play?
  5 'toothache' → Why DON'T YOU GO
    TO the dentist?


⚠ 'NEVER MIND':

  = hechqisi yo'q.


⚠ 'EARACHE' / 'TOOTHACHE':

  = quloq og'rig'i / tish og'rig'i.

tasks.prompt: A: ___ to the park with my friends?  B: No, you can't.
tasks.speak: A: ___ to the park with my friends?  B: No, you can't.

tasks.prompt: A: I'm so sorry I didn't do the washing-up. I was very tired.  B: Never ___. That's OK.

tasks.speak: A: What's ___ Jenny?  B: I've got terrible earache.

tasks.prompt: A: Is ___ I play on my computer?  B: Sure.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ 'Is it OK if I ...?' = ... qilsam bo'ladimi?
tasks.speak: A: Is ___ I play on my computer?  B: Sure.

tasks.prompt: A: I've got terrible toothache.  B: Why ___ the dentist?
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ 'Why don't you go to the dentist?' - maslahat.
tasks.speak: A: I've got terrible toothache.  B: Why ___ the dentist?

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has/have (not) + V3 + yet / already / just / ever / for / since
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She hasn't gone back to work yet. He has been in Rio for three weeks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hali ishga qaytmadi. U uch haftadan beri Rioda.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + had (already/just/never) + V3 + before/when + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She had cooked dinner before her guests arrived. She had just mopped the floor when the dog came in.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin u ovqat pishirgan edi. It kirganda u endigina polni yuvgan edi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I ...? / Is it OK if I ...? → Sure. / No, you can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Is it OK if I play on my computer? - Sure.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the matter / wrong? - I've got terrible earache. - Why don't you go to the doctor?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the matter, Jenny? - I've got terrible earache.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi, Jenni? - Qulog'im qattiq og'riyapti.
